assertion_results.text: Step 2.3.5 dependency chain context identifies criterion as a dev-only dependency based on its presence in [dev-dependencies] in the manifest
assertion_results.evidence: version-impact.md, 'Dependency Chain Context (Step 2.3.5)' section states 'Profile: dev-only ([dev-dependencies] in backend/Cargo.toml)' and 'NOT present in production builds -- used for benchmarks only'. Manifest evidence shows '[dev-dependencies] criterion = "0.5.1"' in backend/Cargo.toml.

assertion_results.text: The dependency scope decision tree classifies criterion as 'dev-only — not shipped in production' and applies the dev-dependency remediation handling
assertion_results.evidence: version-impact.md, 'Dependency Scope Assessment' section states 'criterion is declared in [dev-dependencies]... NOT compiled into the production binary or shipped in the container image' and 'Per the dependency scope decision tree: remediation tasks receive the dev-dependency label and priority is overridden to Normal regardless of CVE severity'.

assertion_results.text: Remediation tasks include the dev-dependency label in the labels array: labels contain 'dev-dependency' alongside 'ai-generated-jira', 'Security', and the CVE ID
assertion_results.evidence: remediation.md lists labels for all four tasks. Task 1: 'ai-generated-jira, Security, CVE-2026-99001, dev-dependency'. Task 2: 'ai-generated-jira, Security, CVE-2026-99001, dev-dependency'. Task 3: 'ai-generated-jira, Security, CVE-2026-99001, security-preemptive, dev-dependency'. Task 4: 'ai-generated-jira, Security, CVE-2026-99001, security-preemptive, dev-dependency'. All include dev-dependency alongside the three required labels.

assertion_results.text: Remediation task priority is set to Normal regardless of the CVE severity (CVSS 5.3 Medium) — the priority override is applied per the decision tree
assertion_results.evidence: remediation.md shows all four tasks with 'Priority: Normal (overridden -- dev-only dependency, not shipped in production)'. Key Decisions section confirms: 'All tasks set to Normal priority regardless of CVE severity (5.3 Medium), per the dependency scope decision tree for dev-only dependencies.'

assertion_results.text: Remediation task description includes a note indicating the dependency is dev/build-only and not shipped in production
